item.title: Daily digest — 2026-07-28
item.description:
Our community has been bustling with activity, and we're excited to share the latest updates with you. The `tenzing` project, led by marton-balazs-kovacs, has released version `0.4.1`, which is now live on the `gh-pages` branch. This milestone is a testament to the team's hard work, and we celebrate the progress made towards improving the tool. Notably, Alex O. Holcombe contributed to the `master` branch by updating the success alert title in `sweet_alert.js`, demonstrating the collaborative spirit of our community. As our projects continue to evolve, we're seeing valuable connections between them, and we look forward to exploring the potential synergies that emerge. With each new release and update, we're one step closer to advancing our shared goals in the scientific community.

6 commits across 3 active repositories this week.

item.title: metacheck: 1 commit today
item.description:
scienceverse/metacheck

The `data_check` branch was the focus of recent work, with commits aimed at enhancing its functionality. On July 26, the `data_check` branch saw the addition of an RO-crate metadata file, replacing the previous collection.json file, and the removal of the full preview from the archive, along with fixes for regex bugs. Another commit on July 28 to the `data_check` branch introduced "iterative improvements" by Lakens, building upon the previous changes. The `data_check` branch is the only branch that was worked on during this period. No other branches were modified in these commits.

1 commit(s) today:
